{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Wander the aisles where chefs haggle for exotic produce and the odd iguana."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Stroll the leafy streets and admire the art deco facades and sidewalk cafés."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Settle in for fragrant halal dishes that please the whole crew."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb among the ruins where the Aztec great temple once towered."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Roar with the masked luchadores as the arena lights blaze."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The Aztec sun stone alone is worth the trip, and the courtyard's umbrella fountain is a quiet marvel."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb to the castle terraces for a view over the treetops that makes the whole city feel like a secret."}]}
A warm little wander through my city — from first tacos to canals, with art, markets and a masked night in between.
